messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a parity gap between SDK v0.9.2 and the REST API when calling /v1/generate. SDK sends param `top_k` but REST expects `topK`. Repro steps below.

alex: Repro (minimal):
```bash
# REST works
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","topK":5,"prompt":"hi"}'
# SDK call fails to change sampling
python -c "from redwood import Redwood; r=Redwood(); print(r.generate(model='rwd-3b', top_k=5, prompt='hi'))"
```

alex: SDK still samples deterministically (top_k ignored). Also saw different retry behavior: REST retries on 429 with exponential backoff, SDK immediately surfaces 429 to caller (no retry).

maya: ugh. thanks for the report. i thought we normalized param names in the python shim. which SDK are you using (pip show)?

alex: redwood-sdk 0.9.2 from pip. installed in a fresh venv.

maya: can reproduce. quick debug: the SDK's serialize_layer strips underscores in names but only for `max_tokens` -> `maxTokens`. top_k got dropped by mistake (we have a whitelist bug).

priya: Impact? is this just sampling, or do customers see regressions in production?

alex: sample apps (starter-chat) set top_k via SDK options so their sampling is unchanged from older behavior — they now default to greedy because top_k is not passed. I found one customer bug report yesterday about unexpectedly lower-diversity responses (likely related).

sam: on the retry side — the SDK used the internal http client that didn't wire up our Retry-After/429 middleware. It was removed in the refactor last quarter. I can PR the middleware reattach.

maya: i'll open two PRs: (1) param mapping whitelist fix for python + TS SDKs; (2) re-add 429 retry middleware and ensure timeouts are consistent with REST.

maya: proposed quick fix for python param mapping: update serialize_params to keep snake_case->camelCase mapping for known sampling params: ["top_k","top_p","temperature","max_tokens"]. simple change, tests included.

alex: can you also add an e2e test that calls the sample app with non-default sampling params and asserts non-greedy tokens? saves chasing this later.

maya: yes. adding e2e. tagging @ci-bot to run the sample-app integration once PR lands.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #4321 — running sample-app integration on linux, macos.

sam: i'll own the retry middleware PR and add a small integration showing SDK handles 429 with three retries and exponential backoff (same policy as gateway).

priya: timeline? we should push a patch release if this affects existing customers.

maya: target patch v0.9.3 with both fixes in ~48 hours. will include release note: "Fix: SDK parameter mapping (top_k/topP) and retry behavior parity with REST".

alex: thanks. also adding a short doc note in devex docs about parameter name mapping to avoid future confusion.

maya: good call. will add a section in the migration guide.

alex: +1. marking thread resolved once PRs merged.

sam: PRs linked in thread: #4321 (retry), #4322 (py param), #4323 (ts param), #4324 (e2e).

maya: 👍
